big_idea: Celebrate the joy of local shopping with Qareeb’s fast 20-minute grocery delivery. The campaign highlights how Qareeb makes everyday errands quick, affordable, and effortless for busy families and professionals in Riyadh, turning 'one more thing' into 'no problem.'
